opportunities.name: Cross-timezone meeting sync email (time difference + holidays)
opportunities.description: For a city pair {city_a}/{city_b} and month {month}, look up the time difference on timeanddate.com, check {city_b}'s country holidays for that month, then draft a 'Sync' email to {recipient} with the offset and the dates to avoid.
steps: Open timeanddate.com > Time Zones > Time Zone Converter
Search for {city_a} and select it from the suggestions
Search for {city_b} and select it from the suggestions
Note how many hours {city_b} is ahead of/behind {city_a}
Go to Calendar > Holidays and observances, open {country_b}'s holiday list (current year)
Note the holidays that fall in {month}
In mail, compose: To={recipient}, Subject='Sync: {city_a} / {city_b}, {month}'
Body='{city_b} is {N} hours ahead from {city_a}. Avoid: {month} {holiday_days}.'
Save or send the draft

instances.values: New York / Berlin, Germany holidays, December; +6h; avoid Dec 25 & 26; to ops@example.com (a San Francisco search at 414–433 was abandoned, then the task was interrupted by SEC browsing)
London / Sydney, Australia holidays 2026, January; +10h; avoid Jan 1 & 26; to ops@example.com

opportunities.name: Open latest 10-K for a ticker on SEC EDGAR
opportunities.description: Search SEC EDGAR for {ticker}, open the company's filings, filter by form type, and open its latest 10-K annual report.
steps: Click the EDGAR company search box and clear it
Type {ticker} and pick the matching company suggestion
On the company filings page, sort/filter by the 'Form' column
Open the latest '10-K Annual report' filing
Note the filing date

instances.values: DDOG (Datadog); the user clicked SEARCH but did not reach the 10-K link

opportunities.name: Account brief email (SEC 10-K + Wikipedia company facts)
opportunities.description: For company {company}/{ticker}, get the latest 10-K filing date from EDGAR and the HQ, employee count and CEO from Wikipedia, then email a brief to {recipient}.
steps: On EDGAR, search {ticker} and open the latest 10-K; note the filing date
On Wikipedia, search {company} and open its article
From the infobox, note the HQ, number of employees and CEO
In mail, compose: To={recipient}, Subject='Account brief: {company} ({ticker})'
Body='{company}: HQ {hq}, {employees} employees, CEO {ceo}. Latest 10-K filed {date}.'
Save or send the draft

instances.values: HubSpot (HUBS), HQ Cambridge, 8,246 employees, CEO Yamini Rangan, 10-K filed 2026-02-11, to marc@example.com
